Lumen is the app\'s own look. Material 3 Expressive is Android\'s: its own pages, icons and motion, your colours, and the newest photos first. Liquid Glass belongs to Lumen\'s look.

Colour is what Material builds its whole scheme from: your wallpaper\'s, one of these, or one you mix. Palette sets how far the other colours stray from it. Pure Black makes the dark theme\'s backgrounds black, which saves power on OLED screens.
Black backgrounds in the dark theme
The icon changes when you leave Lumen, and the Home screen can take a few seconds to show it. Some launchers drop Lumen\'s Home screen shortcut when its icon changes; add it again from the app list.
Liquid Glass: buttons, bars, menus and switches made of glass that bends what\'s behind it. Off, they\'re solid. Reduce Blur keeps the glass with much less blur: clearer, and lighter on the GPU.
